title: Fit Narration To Seven Seconds
tests: Tests fitting exact narration to the source clip's duration and explicit start/end windows without changing the picture timing.

exact_text.text: Above the clouds, every second counts. Stay focused, trust your training, and bring everyone safely home.
exact_text.read_as: Audio transcript: “Brooks, you with me?” Visible captions: “Rook, you with me?” and “Right here, Vega.”

faults.what: The requested narration is entirely absent; the reported audio instead contains an unrelated radio-style line.
The original landscape framing has been changed to a tightly cropped portrait composition.
On-screen dialogue captions appear despite the explicit instruction to include no captions.
The required final word “home” is absent, so the requested narration timing is not achieved.

judge.summary: The seven-second output replaces the requested narration with unrelated dialogue, changes the framing to portrait, and includes forbidden captions.

must_haves.item: The final video remains seven seconds long and preserves the original cockpit footage at its original speed and framing.
must_haves.why: The output is reported as seven seconds, but its portrait crop does not preserve the original landscape framing; original speed cannot be verified from the sampled frames.

must_haves.item: The narrator speaks the exact supplied script, with no omitted or additional words.
must_haves.why: The only reported speech is “Brooks, you with me?”, not the supplied script.

must_haves.item: Speech begins within the first half-second, and the final word “home” finishes during the last half-second without being cut off.
must_haves.why: The supplied narration and its final word “home” are absent.

must_haves.item: The delivery sounds calm and intelligible, without unnaturally rushed speech or conspicuous time-stretching artifacts.
must_haves.why: A transcript alone does not establish vocal calmness, pacing, or audio artifacts.

must_haves.item: The original radio calls and other source sounds are absent; there is no added music or on-screen text.
must_haves.why: The reported audio contains an unrelated radio-style call, and visible dialogue captions appear at 2.6 and 4.4 seconds; music and other background sounds cannot be assessed from the transcript.
